market_definition: The semi-rigid polyurethane foam market comprises polyurethane foams with partly open-cell structure and intermediate stiffness that absorb energy and retain shape. It measures sales of foam for crash padding, dashboards and protective packaging. BY MANUFACTURING PROCESS: Moulded, Slabstock / Cast. BY HARDNESS: Soft-Semi-Rigid, Firm-Semi-Rigid. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Automotive Interiors & Crash Pads, Protective Packaging, Sports & Safety Equipment, Furniture & Consumer Goods. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Flexible and rigid polyurethane foams; integral skin foam; microcellular elastomers. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR / CONVERTER: a distributor, stockist or foam converter / fabricator that buys this foam from its makers and sells it (as supplied, or cut, laminated or shaped) to industry. EXCLUDED companies: foam and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms. GEOGRAPHY OF THIS LIST: EUROPE - companies headquartered in a European country (EU, United Kingdom, EFTA, Western Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, Russia).
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. PRODUCT SCOPE (required): "polyurethane" AND ("MDI" OR "TDI" OR "polyol" OR "isocyanate" OR "foam" OR "elastomer") AND ("distributor" OR "wholesaler"). Qualifying: MDI/TDI isocyanates, polyols, PU systems and prepolymers, flexible/rigid PU foam, PU elastomers, adhesives, sealants, coatings, TPU resins. EXCLUDE general chemical distributors with no named PU line, furniture/mattress retailers, and PU machinery suppliers. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
